description: Who is the cruise director on a Carnival or Royal Caribbean ship today, on a date or on one sailing, with who is next; or which ship a named director is on and where next. With a sailing (sailingId, or ship plus sail date) it also links that sailing's roll call page, where cruisers booked on it meet. From Gangwaze's own schedule, which can change.

date.description: A date or sail date, YYYY-MM-DD; omit for today

director.description: Cruise director name, e.g. "Cory Rogers"; when no ship is asked about

sailingId.description: A sailing id from searchCruises results, e.g. "carnival-breeze:2026-09-21:5"

name: getCruiseDirector
title: Cruise director
